native.th_adaptation_bytes: Actual LOWPAN mesh/IPHC/fragment/UDP control bytes in this MAC payload.
native.th_frame_data_bytes: Actual remaining encoded fragment or datagram content.
native.th_phy_overhead_bytes: Actual preamble/SFD/PHYheader bytes from actual PHY qualification.
native.th_wire_bytes: Actual PPDU bytes including PHY overhead plusPSDU.

native.th_pan_id: Actual dataset PAN ID; broadcastFFFF forbidden.
native.th_network_name_bytes: Actual UTF8 byte count, not Unicode character count.

native.th_pskc_bytes: Provisioned PSKc length; actual secret stored by key reference.
native.th_active_seconds: Actual dataset timestamp seconds, distinct clock synchronization/Unix event time.

native.th_pending_seconds: Actual pending timestamp seconds, distinct change delay.

native.th_routing_version_threshold: Actual API version-threshold value, edition wire width independently qualified.

native.th_leaders_per_partition: Actual one leader in each connected partition.
native.th_mesh_extenders: Actual active extenders in reviewed public baseline≤32; device limit separate.

native.th_leader_weight: Actual uint8 leader preference, no universal default64.
native.th_router_id_min: Actual assignable router-ID range minimum from implementation.
native.th_router_id_max: Actual assignable router-ID range maximum, not active router count.

native.th_upgrade_threshold: Actual promotion threshold, not every ECD always router.
native.th_router_jitter_s: Actual routerselection jitter bound from implementation.
native.th_child_timeout_s: Actual parent child lifetime; not same as poll period.
native.th_poll_ms: Actual OpenThread external poll0 clears override; nonzero≥10ms≤2^26−1.
native.th_effective_poll_ms: Actual resulting sleepy polling bound, zero override is not zero latency.
native.th_poll_wait_ms: Actual worst wait for parent delivery, requires own measured/scheduled evidence.
native.th_csl_period_units: Actual CSL period in units of10symbols (160us), edition≥1.2 supported separately.
native.th_csl_period_us: Actual configured CSL period fromunits, not default for an ordinary SED.
native.th_retries_direct: Actual configured direct frame retry limit, notCAN retry policy.
native.th_retries_indirect: Actual configured indirect retry limit, separate poll-bound count.
native.th_backoff_bound_us: Actual contention/CCA/backoff envelope, not guaranteed byPHYclock.
native.th_retry_bound_us: Actual aggregate retry envelope, not scalar retransmission percentage.
native.th_hop_count: Actual whole packet path forwarding count, not fixed mesh-depthdefault.
native.th_hops_left: Actual RFC4944 mesh header4bit hopsleft;15requires deepfield.
native.th_ipv6_mtu: Reviewed RFC4944 IPv6 linkMTU1280, not rawradio frame size.
native.th_fragment_size: Actual11bit uncompressed datagram_size shared by fragments.
native.th_fragment_tag: Actual16bit tag shared across datagram and source/destination.
native.th_fragment_offset_units: Actual subsequent datagram offset in8uncompressed octets.
native.th_fragment_offset_bytes: Actual decoded offset, not compressed wire offset.
native.th_fragment_coverage_bytes: Actual represented uncompressed bytes in this fragment.
native.th_fragment_header_bytes: Actual FRAG1four or FRAGNfive bytes, NONEzero.
native.th_reassembly_buffer_bytes: Actual available buffer for full uncompressed datagram.
native.th_iphc_base_bytes: Actual base2 or3 withcontext extension, excludes inlinefields.
native.th_forwards: Actual forwards othernodes; children do not.
native.th_border_router: Actual external-network role, not mandatory for local Thread.
native.th_dataset_verified: Actual wholeTLV validity, duplicates/length/value checks and matching commissionedconfig.
native.th_mac_security_verified: Actual linksecurity configured and validated, no end-to-end applicationsecurity inference.
native.th_obtain_network_key: Actual out-of-band key provisioning permitted by policy.
native.th_toble: Actual ToBLE enabled, not same2.4GHz radio capacity.
native.th_last_fragment: Actual final fragment; preceding fragments eightoctet alignment.
native.th_reassembled: Actual complete matching tagged datagram reassembled.
native.th_checksum_elided: Actual UDPchecksum elision, only under explicitupperlayerauthorization.
native.th_configuration_source: Actual commissioned configuration and role evidence.
native.th_security_source: Actual commissioned credential references andsecuritypolicy evidence.
native.th_schedule_source: Actual whole path, queues, polls, retries, fragmentation and delivery bounds.
native.th_parent_id: Actual parentidentity for child, not generated frommesh-extender count.
native.th_network_key_ref: Actual credentialstore reference; never secret keybytes.
native.th_pskc_ref: Actual credentialstore PSKc reference; never secret PSKcbytes.
native.th_endpoint_address: Actual IPv6 address; applicationML-EID separate from topologyRLOC.
native.th_peer_address: Actual IPv6 peeraddress scoped tobound network.
native.bitrate: Actual selected PHYbitrate; reviewed2.4GHz OQPSK250000 conditional sourceproposal only. Inputmin1 is numeric positivity, not a standard radio mode minimum or operational capacity.
